<translate>
The '''Z Sword''' is a huge, unbreakable blade that uses the '''claymore''' moveset: heavy, wide and slow swings that trade speed for big, hard-hitting blows and the highest critical damage of the signature weapons. You earn it on the [[Special:MyLanguage/Sacred Kai Planet|Sacred Kai Planet]] by completing [[Special:MyLanguage/Old Kai|Old Kai]]'s challenge.
</translate>

<translate>
== Getting it ==

Complete '''Old Kai's Ultimate Challenge''', which chains every training minigame into one run (see [[Special:MyLanguage/Training Minigames|Training Minigames]]). The Z Sword is given once per character.
</translate>

<translate>
== Fighting with it ==

* '''Moveset:''' claymore, with heavy, wide, slow swings.
* '''Critical hits:''' 15% chance, 25% critical damage.
* It is unbreakable.
* While you carry it in your inventory, it is shown on your character's back.

See [[Special:MyLanguage/Special Weapons|Special Weapons]] for how movesets, combos, blocking and parrying work.
</translate>

<translate>
== Quests that need it ==

* '''The Z Sword and Ultimate Power''' ([[Special:MyLanguage/Buu Saga|Buu Saga]] quest 24) asks you to obtain the Z Sword and reach Ultimate level 1.
* The sidequest '''Old Kai's Ritual''', given by [[Special:MyLanguage/King Kai|King Kai]], asks you to bring the Z Sword to Old Kai.
</translate>
